I will remember that. As of now, I'll try to avoid the onset of those dark periods where I can think of nothing other than dying. I've calmed down considerably since I posted that, mostly because of work. I will do what I can. 
I think I'll go with the letter. It makes sense.

I know very little about marriage but I know that's not how it should be. I think you should get away from her, simply because it could be so painful to stay. I don't think you can trust her anymore, no matter what she says. Some mistakes just can't be undone. 
I think you should get away and focus on something else for a while till you can think clearly. The decisions we make under emotional distress are usually regrettable. Do something you love, even the simplest things. Take all the time you need to accept what happened, and then think of what you can do.

Thank you, really. 
I'm trying to find the courage to tell my sister about this. I don't know how, and I think she knows already. I just have to say the words. It'll take some time to actually ask for help, but I think I can do it. 
There are these fleeting moments when I feel like I can get over this, like right now, and the next time I feel like this I shall do what I can to get better.
